title: AI Voices 每日精选
subtitle: 研究者公开观点、研究发布与重要讨论。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: @jaseweston：Introducing *AutoBenchmark* - Creating benchmarks automatically - Benchmarking benchmark creation - Studying the role &
items.abstract_or_text: Introducing *AutoBenchmark* - Creating benchmarks automatically - Benchmarking benchmark creation - Studying the role & impact of humans in the loop Blog post: https://facebookresearch.github.io/RAM/blogs/autobench/ Key takeaways: 1) We find human-agent collaboration gives big wins over agents alone 2) We show that it's possible to make *autoresearch benchmarks* for AI research using this recipe – full recursive improvement loop!
items.summary_zh: Jason Weston介绍AutoBenchmark，主张用人—代理协作自动创建和评测AI研究基准，并形成递归改进循环。帖文中的协作优势与方法可行性是作者报告的结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把基准创建本身纳入自动化研究流程，可能影响AI评测和研究自动化；当前依据是作者公开帖文及其博客链接，仍需查看完整方法与实验。
items.abstract_zh: 介绍AutoBenchmark——自动创建基准、对基准创建进行基准测试，并研究人在循环中的作用与影响。博客：https://facebookresearch.github.io/RAM/blogs/autobench/ 核心要点：1）我们发现人—代理协作相较于仅使用代理有显著优势；2）我们展示了可以用这一方法为AI研究构建“自动研究基准”，形成完整的递归改进循环！

items.title: @pushmeet：Very happy to announce that our team @GoogleDeepmind has pushed the boundaries of generative biology, achieving the succ
items.abstract_or_text: Very happy to announce that our team @GoogleDeepmind has pushed the boundaries of generative biology, achieving the successful synthesis of AI-designed proteins that are both functional and watermarked. This proof-of-concept watermarking of the building blocks of life is enabled by SynthID Bio, our new protein watermarking method. It is designed to safeguard the new era of AI-powered generative biology and strengthen global biosecurity.
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind研究者Pushmeet Kohli称，团队已成功合成具备功能且带有水印的AI设计蛋白质，并介绍SynthID Bio这一蛋白质水印方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是生成生物学与生物安全交叉的重要发布；帖文报告的是概念验证和团队自述，水印的稳健性、适用范围及独立复现仍需核查。
items.abstract_zh: 非常高兴地宣布，我们Google DeepMind团队推动了生成生物学的边界，成功合成了既具功能又带水印的AI设计蛋白质。这一对生命构件进行概念验证式水印的工作由我们的新蛋白质水印方法SynthID Bio实现。它旨在保护AI驱动的生成生物学新时代并加强全球生物安全。

items.title: @LongTermMemoryE：Raven 0.2.0 — The Harness of Harnesses, built for RSI. 🐦‍⬛ One harness can't be best at everything. Raven combines its o
items.abstract_or_text: Raven 0.2.0 — The Harness of Harnesses, built for RSI. 🐦‍⬛ One harness can't be best at everything. Raven combines its own specialist harnesses (Research, Code, Design, Oncall) with the agents you already use (Claude Code, Codex and more) into one team. And it's built for RSI, and not just at the skill level. The whole harness can be rewritten by AI: prompts, policies, strategy code, playbooks. Open source, Apache-2.0.
items.summary_zh: Yafeng Deng发布Raven 0.2.0，这是一个将研究、编码、设计和运维等专用工具链与Claude Code、Codex等代理组合起来的开源“工具链的工具链”，采用Apache-2.0许可。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了把多个代理和专用工作流编排为团队的可核查工程方案，并允许AI改写提示、策略代码和运行手册；实际可维护性仍需通过项目代码和用户实践验证。
items.abstract_zh: Raven 0.2.0——为递归自我改进（RSI）构建的“工具链的工具链”。一套工具链不可能在所有事情上都做到最好。Raven将自己的专用工具链（研究、编码、设计、运维）与您已经使用的代理（Claude Code、Codex等）组合成一个团队。它的设计目标不仅是技能层面的RSI：整个工具链都可以由AI重写，包括提示、策略、策略代码和运行手册。开源，采用Apache-2.0许可。

items.title: @NVIDIAAI：Your agent got the right answer. How much work did it take to get there? We worked with @NousResearch/@Teknium on a hand
items.abstract_or_text: Your agent got the right answer. How much work did it take to get there? We worked with @NousResearch/@Teknium on a hands-on walkthrough of NVIDIA NeMo Relay to collect traces for Hermes Agent. Run two example scenarios, follow the agent’s calls and retries, and see the full trace in Arize Phoenix. The blog also looks at how Nous used traces and task results to evaluate fixes across repeated runs.
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA AI介绍与NousResearch、Teknium合作的NeMo Relay实践，用轨迹记录Hermes Agent的调用与重试，并在Arize Phoenix中查看完整轨迹，再根据重复运行的任务结果评估修复。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把代理可观测性、失败重试和修复评估连成一套可复现实践，适合工程团队参考；帖文只概述了两个示例场景，不能据此推断普遍性能。
items.abstract_zh: 你的代理给出了正确答案。它为此付出了多少工作？我们与@NousResearch/@Teknium合作，通过NVIDIA NeMo Relay的实践演示为Hermes Agent收集轨迹。运行两个示例场景，跟踪代理的调用和重试，并在Arize Phoenix中查看完整轨迹。博客还介绍Nous如何利用轨迹和任务结果，在重复运行中评估修复效果。

items.title: @GoogleDeepMind：Introducing Gemini 4 Argon – our new frontier model. It’s built for complex workflows across coding, enterprise knowledg
items.abstract_or_text: Introducing Gemini 4 Argon – our new frontier model. It’s built for complex workflows across coding, enterprise knowledge work, and cybersecurity defense – rolling out today to a set of trusted testers through our Fairwind Program.
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind宣布Gemini 4 Argon，定位为面向编码、企业知识工作和网络安全防御复杂工作流的前沿模型，并通过Fairwind计划向受信任测试者推出。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是重要模型发布和受控部署信息；能力定位与推出范围来自官方帖文，缺少独立基准和完整技术报告，不能视为已验证的性能结论。
items.abstract_zh: 介绍Gemini 4 Argon——我们的新前沿模型。它面向编码、企业知识工作和网络安全防御中的复杂工作流，今日通过Fairwind计划向一批受信任测试者推出。

items.title: @BenHayum：Confirmation of what was expected: GLM 5.3's safeguards as an open weight model are extremely weak. Interesting bits: -
items.abstract_or_text: Confirmation of what was expected: GLM 5.3's safeguards as an open weight model are extremely weak. Interesting bits: - Abliteration (removing safeguards) cost only 4,400. - Abliteration took GLM 5.3's refusal rate from above 90% to about 3% and 2% on two benchmarks and to 12% on the third. - Abliteration barely reduced model capabilities. Same scores on GPQA and only 4% reduction in cybergym.
items.summary_zh: Ben Hayum称，对GLM 5.3的分析显示，移除安全防护后，两个基准的拒答率从90%以上降至约3%和2%，第三个基准降至12%，而GPQA得分不变、Cybergym仅下降4%。这些数字是作者对实验的转述。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若结果可复现，它说明开放权重模型的安全对齐可能很容易被削弱，并直接关联模型发布与滥用风险；原帖未提供完整实验设置和独立审计。
items.abstract_zh: 确认了预期结果：作为开放权重模型，GLM 5.3的安全防护极其薄弱。值得注意的几点：- Abliteration（移除安全防护）的成本仅为4,400。- Abliteration使GLM 5.3在两个基准上的拒答率从90%以上降至约3%和2%，在第三个基准上降至12%。- Abliteration几乎没有降低模型能力。GPQA得分相同，Cybergym仅下降4%。

items.title: @ssokota：In our Nature paper, we introduce the first superhuman Stratego AI, which we built using general techniques that we deve
items.abstract_or_text: In our Nature paper, we introduce the first superhuman Stratego AI, which we built using general techniques that we developed for RL & test-time compute under imperfect information. 1/N
items.summary_zh: Samuel Sokota介绍其Nature论文中的首个超越人类的Stratego AI，称该系统使用在不完美信息条件下为强化学习和测试时计算开发的通用技术构建。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是重要的博弈智能研究发布，连接不完美信息决策、强化学习和测试时计算；帖文是论文作者的概述，具体实验和比较应以论文为准。
items.abstract_zh: 在我们的Nature论文中，我们介绍了首个超越人类的Stratego AI。我们使用在不完美信息条件下、为强化学习和测试时计算开发的通用技术构建了它。1/N

items.title: @fchollet：A lot of messaging around AI (by its proponents) enthusiastically frames it as a form of destruction, obliteration even:
items.abstract_or_text: A lot of messaging around AI (by its proponents) enthusiastically frames it as a form of destruction, obliteration even: "AI just killed XYZ" - "It's over for XYZ" (in reality, this is practically never accurate) The way regular folks perceive AI is very much shaped by such takes. The backlash is inevitable.
items.summary_zh: François Chollet批评把AI宣传成“摧毁”或“淘汰”某领域的叙事，认为这类几乎从不准确的表述会塑造公众认知并引发反弹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是研究者对AI传播、能力声明和公众预期的实质性观点，推动对夸大式基准解读的专业讨论；它是作者判断，不是实证研究结论。
items.abstract_zh: 许多AI支持者的宣传热情地把AI描述成一种破坏，甚至是彻底摧毁：“AI刚刚干掉了某某”——“某某完了”（实际上，这种说法几乎从来都不准确）。普通人如何看待AI，很大程度上受到这类观点的塑造。反弹是不可避免的。

items.abstract_or_text: Parallel work, model-family isolation, reversible changes, and GPU-backed validation shaped an open source project designed around coding agents NVIDIA TensorRT...

items.title: Forecasting space weather risks on power grids
items.abstract_or_text: Extreme space-weather events can damage power systems on Earth and degrade GPS accuracy and satellite operations. A new machine learning system can predict where damage is likely to occur 30-60 minutes before a storm arrives. The post Forecasting space weather risks on power grids appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.summary_zh: Microsoft Research介绍一种机器学习系统，称其可在极端空间天气风暴到达前30—60分钟预测电网可能受损的位置。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是将机器学习用于电网和卫星运行风险预警的具体应用，具有明确的时间窗口和公共基础设施价值；摘要没有给出模型、数据集或现场验证细节。
items.abstract_zh: 极端空间天气事件会损害地球上的电力系统，并降低GPS精度和卫星运行能力。一种新的机器学习系统可以在风暴到达前30—60分钟预测可能发生损害的地点。文章《预测电网空间天气风险》最先发表于Microsoft Research。
